bio: The Crown at Ampney Brook is a lovingly restored 16th century inn nestled in the Cotswolds countryside. Indulge in one of Britain’s most loved traditions with Afternoon Tea in the warming surrounds of the restaurant.  A delectable selection of sweet treats and savoury delights await, complete with freshly baked scones, clotted cream and preserves.  Why not book your own private Afternoon Tea party, hosted in the characterful surroundings of alfresco domes, situated along the Ampney Brook, or private dining rooms, The Secret Garden Room, The Hide, or The Eaves.  The menu includes the highest quality, seasonal, farm to table ingredients packed into our traditional Afternoon Tea delights.  Afternoon Tea is served Monday to Saturday from 12pm - 5pm and advance booking is recommended.
